decisions.reason: Approval of these three clips applies the existing approval gate but does not change its authority, eligibility, quota-counting, or rejection rules; the approval outcome is already represented as execution evidence.
The publishing instructions establish an Instagram Reel format but do not change the required 45-to-60-second clip duration.
The source approves and schedules completed clips for Instagram publication without changing which source videos may be selected.
Approval of the completed clips does not modify the standing requirement that each clip contain a complete standalone teaching moment; execution status must not be propagated as a MODIFY.
The message authorizes three clips for publication but does not state that the deferred monthly quota resumes or that these clips alter the 100-approved-clips-per-month requirement.
The publication decision does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, assignment status, training, or responsibilities.
These are approved launch clips for publication, not a change to the earlier qualification method, clip count, success condition, or deadline.
The source does not revise the clean and simple editing standard; approval of a batch is an outcome rather than a value change to that standard.
The prescribed Instagram post caption is distinct from the on-video caption color, font, effects, and lettering-style requirements.

Updating a Notion card with publication details is a post-publication tracking instruction, not a change to the workflow for submitting clips or review links; it belongs with publishing rather than clip submission.
Approval of the clips does not modify the standing standard for selecting strong and impactful source moments.
